candidate.blueprint_locator: Safety and Infection Prevention and Control: apply infection-prevention practices, use disinfection/sterilization principles appropriately, and maintain reusable equipment safely to prevent transmission.
candidate.blueprint_topic: Safety and Infection Prevention and Control — bronchoscope/endoscope reprocessing and high-level disinfection
candidate.educational_objective: Reprocess a reusable flexible bronchoscope by meticulous cleaning of external surfaces and internal channels followed by at least high-level disinfection before the device is reused.

options.A: Meticulously clean the bronchoscope, including accessible internal channels, and then perform at least high-level disinfection before reuse.
options.B: Use low-level surface disinfection only if the previous client had no known infection.
options.C: Perform high-level disinfection without prior cleaning as long as the disinfectant is circulated through the bronchoscope.
options.D: Reprocess only the exterior surface because the bronchoscope's internal channels do not require the same level of cleaning.

candidate.rationale: Current CDC disinfection guidance states that heat-sensitive flexible endoscopes, including bronchoscopes, must be properly cleaned and at minimum undergo high-level disinfection after each use. CDC further states that meticulous cleaning must precede high-level disinfection or sterilization and that endoscope reprocessing includes cleaning both external surfaces and internal channels before high-level disinfection. Therefore A is correct. B provides an inadequate level of reprocessing, C incorrectly omits the essential cleaning step, and D ignores the internal channels that must also be cleaned and disinfected.
candidate.source_claim_supported: Reusable flexible bronchoscopes require meticulous cleaning, including internal-channel cleaning, followed by at least high-level disinfection after each use before reuse.
candidate.source_document_title: Disinfection of Healthcare Equipment — Guideline for Disinfection and Sterilization in Healthcare Facilities
candidate.source_locator: Flexible endoscopes/bronchoscopes section: all heat-sensitive endoscopes including bronchoscopes must be properly cleaned and at minimum high-level disinfected after each use. Cleaning section: meticulous cleaning must precede high-level disinfection or sterilization. Reprocessing steps include cleaning external surfaces and brushing/flushing internal channels before high-level disinfection with perfusion of accessible channels.
candidate.source_organization: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC)

candidate.stem: A reusable flexible bronchoscope has just been used for a client. Which reprocessing step is required before the bronchoscope is used again?
